APPLY_CE_B_INCL
description: Require continuous enrollment in the baseline period

name: APPLY_CE_F_INCL
description: Require continuous enrollment in the follow-up period

name: APPLY_NO_BL_AGENTS_INCL
description: Require no MM agents during baseline (new users)

name: # --- Cohort EXCLUSION criteria (set FALSE to drop a rule) ---

# DESIGN (this project only): the parent/Overall cohort runs through Step 6 (qualifying MM + age + CE + treatment-naive + treated). The NDMM-specific exclusions (other-malig / pregnancy / baseline-MM-dx / clinical-trial) are turned OFF at the parent here and re-applied where the spec requires inside 06_ndmm_dashboard.R at the correct LOT1 or study-period anchor (pregnancy is study-period). The parent CODE is untouched - these are config toggles - so other projects using the parent with their own config still get the full funnel.
APPLY_PREGNANCY_EXCL
description: OFF at parent (Overall=Step6); NDMM re-applies it from pregnancy.csv / raw claims over the study period

name: APPLY_CLINTRIAL_EXCL
description: OFF at parent (Overall=Step6); not in the NDMM IE spec (S6.2.1) - confirm with team before any reuse

name: # APPLY_OTHER_MALIG_EXCL ships FALSE by design for the NDMM workflow: the parent leaves other-malig OFF so 06_ndmm_dashboard.R can re-apply it with the MM-adjacent override (keeps MGUS / solitary + extramedullary plasmacytoma / plasma-cell leukemia / secondary bone). TRUE drops those patients upstream and breaks the NDMM cohort. Caveat: with FALSE the Overall (non-NDMM) cohort has no other-malig exclusion.
APPLY_OTHER_MALIG_EXCL
description: Exclude other malignancies (FALSE by design - NDMM dashboard owns this via the MM-adjacent override; see comment above)

name: APPLY_BASELINE_MM_EXCL
description: OFF at parent (Overall=Step6); NDMM defines newly-diagnosed by treatment (no prior MM tx in 12-mo) not dx history
